game_model_choice.rule: use playoff-specific parameters if validation playoff log loss improves by more than 0.002

wins_baseline_actual_net_rating.note: uses the season's actual point differential; not a prediction

better_record.note: better regular-season record wins; probabilities fixed at 70/30 for log loss

series.reason: only 45 held-out series (2013-2015) have game-level data; the rule requires at least 100

bracket.reason: bracket replay uses the series model, which has too few held-out series

labels.component_note: Pre-registered rule used validation R^2 only (offense and defense both passed). The test seasons then showed defense at a much lower R^2, so the rule was tightened to require the minimum on BOTH validation and test. This only withholds output.
